## Checks

- [ ] `npm test` passes — the self-host drills, run against a throwaway instance
- [ ] A bug fix starts with a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] The docs that describe this behaviour are updated in the same change
- [ ] One change only — nothing unrelated rides along

Bigger than a small fix? CONTRIBUTING.md asks for an issue conversation first, so the work has a home before it is written. Link that issue above if there is one.
